mission_04: Positional encoding uses sin and cos functions with geometrically increasing wavelengths to give the model information about the position of each element in the sequence.
The scaling factor sqrt(d_k) in dot-product attention prevents the softmax from entering regions with extremely small gradients when d_k is large.
Multi-head attention splits the model dimension by the number of heads, computes attention independently for each head, then concatenates and projects the results.
